notes.title: A new hero, a new level and a new game mode!
notes.content:
Welcome all VR players!
We hasten to inform you that a major update has been released in our game!

We added  3  innovations:  new hero ,  new level  and  new mode .
Let's talk about everything in order.

 The new hero -  Hatsume  
Female Ninja  Hatsume  is a sophisticated killer. Its fast speed of movement, a sharp sword and the ability to jerk to its target or vice versa to retreat from the enemy, not only compensate for the lack of long-range weapons, but also make it a dangerous enemy, especially at short distances.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36057953/dd1cf8511536c532ac33ce3d69bef0aa8369db6c.png

 New level -  Courtyard  
A compact level made in the style of classic network shooters. The scene is the administrative building and courtyard of the nuclear waste processing plant.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36057953/da5b1aa0ea1e8077827d9b6e3d511d8048564467.png

  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36057953/45db832f95d9dd0e16a4390093777961610deeb9.png  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36057953/cb358cbbdcb070bf6a81bfbd02c9528cd20e5976.png  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36057953/64dd35c928f1b12dc8f9a9f96cc0731cfbe9b8a4.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36057953/e3b9cd2c2e7c0228f02bfad39e0452ba4a14d77c.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36057953/662f930f4b2cd997e09bf69812881d47df4f66d5.png

 New mode -  Capture  
In this mode, you have to fight for the control points located on the map. The team that captures the point receives points. Opponents to win will need to intercept the point and hold it to completely capture and outweigh the points in their favor. Maps may contain one or more control points.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36057953/d1070d83b0b6659a90efc8ecbc6aa43ce1f894e7.png

All these innovations increase the variety and bring more fun to the game!
We welcome all your feedback!
Have a nice game!

notes.title: New effects and other updates
notes.content:
We continue to update our game!

And for the doctor it turned out very good ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Interface update, change of movement mode and much more
notes.content:
Greetings to all!

In our game Iron Blood VR, an update has been released that affects many aspects of the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36057953/857295658cffb58a995b9f583b954fdbb2be325f.gif

 List of changes: 
 We listened to the requests of the players and changed the movement system. Now the player does not move in the direction where the helmet is directed, but in the direction of the left controller.
 Changed the visual style of the game user interface. Now it looks beautiful, is informatively located on the hands and does not obstruct the view.
 Improved the artificial intelligence of bots, as well as trained them in throwing grenades.
 Removed the model of secondary weapons, confusing players. Now abilities and teleportations are animatedly cast from the hand.
 Fixed many bugs that interfere with the comfortable gameplay.
 Made the game balance settings.
 And also made other minor corrections and improvements.


But we do not stop there, much is yet to come!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36057953/a90343b52ca23543a1553782b314759f29f24242.gif

notes.title: Iron Blood VR is available now
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36057953/2181e956011b9b69721e67c25a81b2a46346c996.jpg

The game Iron Blood VR became available in early access in Steam!

Try the new team-based class shooter in Virtual Reality. Join the game development process, participate in discussions or polls, and offer your ideas and comments. We will listen to your feedback and advice.

The game currently has 3 classes of heroes:
Rayan - cool damage dealer;
Diesel- powerful player protecting allies;
Amelia - elegant doctor.

Two game locations:
Angar - A small secret military depot disguised as a civilian one.
City - A strategically important area of ​​the city for which there is a battle between the ruling organization and the opposition.

One game mode:
Team death match.

Over time, there will be more heroes, locations and modes!
Start following the development of the game and participate in it now!
